verdict.rationale: An LLM observability and evaluation platform could plausibly offer scheduled evaluations or recurring workflows, so this axis applies. The evidence shows only event-triggered alerts and webhook automations, plus coding agents that iterate "continuously" through the MCP server. Neither is a documented recurring schedule: event-driven triggers and agent loops are not the same as scheduling recurring jobs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
